analysis.title: GS Crypto: Monthly On-chain & Market Data (Oct 2026)
key_insights: October 2026 broke from Bitcoin's historical 'Uptober' strength. BTC ended the month -7.4% MoM, ETH -16.2% and SOL -19.3%. GS says most of the move came in the final week, tied to security incidents.
US-listed spot ETFs saw net outflows in October: BTC -$549.6mm, ETH -$1.6bn, SOL -$143.7mm. Aggregate AUM is $98.2bn for BTC, $13.2bn for ETH and $1.4bn for SOL.
Despite the correction, ETH and SOL volumes fell. Trusted spot volumes were -17.3% (ETH) and -28.7% (SOL) MoM. CME front 3 month futures volumes were -14.4% (ETH) and -28.7% (SOL) MoM.
BTC trusted spot and CME front 3 month futures volumes were roughly flat, -1.5% and -0.9% MoM. BTC network activity was largely flat versus the prior month.
Staking yields diverge. Ethereum's yield is stable near 3% because issuance adjusts to the aggregate amount staked. Total ETH staked is +23.6% YoY, with about 36% of supply staked.

Solana's staking yield is trending down because most rewards come from a fixed disinflation schedule that cuts new SOL issuance 15% a year. A vote to accelerate the cut to 30% was recently passed. SOL staking yield is -20.6% YoY and supply staked is only +5.1% YoY.

Solana activated Alpenglow on 21 Oct, cutting transaction finality from several seconds to a fraction of a second. Ethereum advanced Glamsterdam on the Sepolia test network on 6 Oct, which enables parallel transaction processing and a tripling of baseline capacity.
GS reads the upgrades as a positioning contrast. Solana is leaning on ultra-low-latency finality, while Ethereum keeps scaling base-layer capacity as a high-capacity settlement layer.
ETH/BTC fell -9.5% MoM. SOL/BTC and SOL/ETH fell -12.9% and -3.8% MoM.
BTC miner revenue rose +8.9% MoM on a higher average October price versus September. Miner supply sent to exchanges fell -6.6% MoM.

ETH network activity weakened. Average daily active addresses fell -5.2% and transaction count -5.8% MoM. Blob fees rose +45.3% MoM while blob transaction count was flat, which GS says points to concentrated L2 activity.
ETH monthly total validator revenue fell -2.5% MoM and monthly total ETH burnt rose +72.3% MoM.
SOL network activity was muted. Average daily active addresses fell -6.5% and transaction counts -9.0% MoM. Monthly total SOL burnt rose +12.6% MoM.
crypto_views: BTC -7.4% MoM in October, against its seasonal 'Uptober' strength. ETH -16.2% and SOL -19.3%. Most of the decline came in the final week, tied to security incidents.
US spot ETF net outflows in October: BTC -$549.6mm (AUM $98.2bn), ETH -$1.6bn (AUM $13.2bn), SOL -$143.7mm (AUM $1.4bn).

ETH staking yield is stable near 3% with about 36% of supply staked. SOL staking yield is falling on its fixed disinflation schedule, and the protocol voted to raise the annual issuance cut from 15% to 30%.
Solana activated Alpenglow on 21 Oct for sub-second finality. Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade advanced on the Sepolia testnet on 6 Oct, targeting a tripling of baseline capacity.
risk_factors: Security incidents in the final week of October drove most of the monthly decline.
Continued US spot ETF outflows across BTC, ETH and SOL products.
Falling SOL staking yield from fixed disinflation, with supply staked growing only +5.1% YoY.
vol_and_positioning: ETH and SOL spot and CME futures volumes fell during the October drawdown, so the selloff came on declining activity. BTC volumes were roughly flat.
ETH/BTC -9.5% MoM and SOL/BTC -12.9% MoM show ETH and SOL underperforming BTC.
